title: Eagle Mfg 20-Gallon HDPE Open-Head Poly Drum with Lever Lock Ring - Blue
description: The EAGLE MFG 1623BLK is a 20 gal. open-head poly drum for storage and handling of compatible materials. It is made of high-density polyethylene and features a regular lid with a plastic lever-lock closure and lock ring for closing the lid. The drum has a black finish and a UN/DOT rated design. Key Features: Capacity: 20 gal. capacity. Material: High-density polyethylene construction. Lid Type: Regular lid. Opening Closure Type: Plastic lever-lock with lock ring. Dimensions: 30.5 in. outside height x 15.75 in. outside length. Color: Black. Standards: UN/DOT rated.
